capsule.definition: A pill in the form of a small rounded gelatinous container with medicine inside.

cream.definition: To put on cream, as on one's face or body.

ointment.definition: Semisolid preparation (usually containing a medicine) applied externally as a remedy or for soothing an irritation.

eye-drops.definition: A medication used in pharmacies to treat eye disorders.

inhaler.definition: A dispenser that produces a chemical vapor to be inhaled in order to relieve nasal congestion.

injection.definition: The forceful insertion of a substance under pressure.

patch.definition: A small area of ground covered by specific vegetation.

lozenge.definition: A dose of medicine in the form of a small pellet.

pill-bottle.definition: A small container designed to store medication in pill form.

blister-pack.definition: This type of package seals a product between a rigid cardboard backing and a transparent plastic cover.

suppository.definition: A small plug of medication designed for insertion into the rectum or vagina where it melts.

nasal-spray.definition: A medication used in pharmacies to treat nasal conditions.

ear-drops.definition: A medication used in pharmacies to treat ear disorders.

ointment-tube.definition: A container used in pharmacies to store ointment for oral use.

lotion.definition: A smooth liquid put on the skin to protect or soften it.

injection-pen.definition: A pen used in pharmacies to inject medications for oral use.

prescription-counter.definition: A counter used in pharmacies to dispense medications for oral use.

cash-register.definition: A store machine that records purchases, adds their prices, and prints a receipt for the customer.

medicine-shelf.definition: A shelf used in pharmacies to store medications for oral use.

scale.definition: A device that measures how heavy a person or object is.

mortar-and-pestle.definition: A tool used in pharmacies to mix mortar and pestle for construction.

pill-counter.definition: A device or tray used by pharmacy staff to count solid-dose medicines accurately.
pill-counter.exampleUsage: The pharmacy technician used the pill counter as part of dispensing work.

label-printer.definition: A compact device produces self-adhesive labels for identifying and organizing materials in classrooms and homes.

barcode-scanner.definition: An electronic device that reads printed barcodes to identify products or records.
barcode-scanner.exampleUsage: The barcode scanner verified the product code.

computer.definition: A machine for performing calculations automatically.

medicine-cabinet.definition: Home health supplies include medicines, vitamins, and first aid materials kept in a medicine cabinet.

refrigerated-medicine.definition: Medicines kept at a low temperature for preservation.

digital-scale.definition: Involving electronic technology that measures weight or quantity and presents the result on a scale.

patient-profile.definition: A record of a patient's health.

bandage.definition: A piece of soft material that covers and protects an injured part of the body.

plaster.definition: A white material that becomes hard and is used for casting shapes.

blood-pressure-monitor.definition: A device used to measure blood pressure.

glucose-meter.definition: A device used to measure glucose levels in blood.

pregnancy-test.definition: A medical test used to find out whether a person is pregnant.

hand-sanitizer.definition: A liquid or gel used to clean your hands when soap and water are unavailable.

disinfectant.definition: An agent (as heat or radiation or a chemical) that destroys microorganisms that might carry disease.

cotton-ball.definition: A fungal disease that infects cranberry plants and damages their growth.

gauze.definition: (medicine) bleached cotton cloth of plain weave used for bandages and dressings.

herbal-remedy.definition: A preparation made from medicinal plants or other botanical materials is used to treat illness or support health.

antibiotic.definition: Of or relating to antibiotic drugs.

painkiller.definition: A medicine used to relieve pain.

anti-inflammatory.definition: Reducing inflammation, the body’s response that can cause swelling, pain, heat, and redness.

antihistamine.definition: A medicine used to treat allergies and hypersensitive reactions and colds.

antacid.definition: An agent that counteracts or neutralizes acidity (especially in the stomach).

shampoo.definition: A liquid soap used for washing your hair and scalp.

conditioner.definition: A hair product used after shampoo to make hair softer and easier to manage.

body-lotion.definition: A moisturizing product spread over the skin after bathing to prevent dryness.

sunscreen.definition: A cream spread on the skin.

lip-balm.definition: A soft product put on the lips to stop them becoming dry or sore.

deodorant.definition: A product put on the body to prevent or hide unpleasant smells.

contact-lens-solution.definition: A solution used to apply contact lenses.

vitamin.definition: Any of a group of organic substances essential in small quantities to normal metabolism.

supplement.definition: To add as a supplement to what seems insufficient.

probiotic.definition: A dietary supplement containing live bacteria, usually taken after a course of antibiotics to replenish the damaged gastrointestinal flora.

cough-syrup.definition: A sweet-tasting liquid medicine taken by mouth to ease coughing and irritation in the chest.

throat-lozenge.definition: A lozenge used to relieve throat pain.

insulin.definition: Hormone secreted by the isles of Langerhans in the pancreas.

drug-interaction-checker.definition: A tool used to check for drug interactions.

compounding-area.definition: A place where pharmaceutical products are compounded.

clean-room.definition: A specially engineered workspace keeps dust, chemical vapors, microbes, and other pollutants at extremely low levels for research and precision manufacturing.

pharmacist.definition: A health professional trained in the art of preparing and dispensing drugs.

pharmacy-technician.definition: A trained pharmacy worker who supports pharmacists with preparation, records, stock, and other regulated tasks.
pharmacy-technician.exampleUsage: The pharmacy technician entered the prescription information under pharmacist supervision.

cashier.definition: To discard or do away with.

customer.definition: A person who pays for goods or services.

delivery-driver.definition: A worker whose job is to transport and deliver items to customers or locations.
delivery-driver.exampleUsage: The delivery driver carried sealed pharmacy packages.

manager.definition: A person who controls resources and expenditures.

stock-clerk.definition: A worker who receives, organizes, records, and replenishes store inventory.
stock-clerk.exampleUsage: The stock clerk checked the shelf inventory.

security-guard.definition: A person who protects a building and its people.

cleaner.definition: A preparation used in cleaning something.

pharmacy-assistant.definition: A worker who supports pharmacy operations with customer service, stock, and administrative tasks within local rules.
pharmacy-assistant.exampleUsage: The pharmacy assistant directed the customer to the consultation counter.

pharmacy-intern.definition: A pharmacy student or trainee completing supervised practical experience.
pharmacy-intern.exampleUsage: The pharmacy intern worked under the supervision of a licensed pharmacist.

pharmacy-manager.definition: A pharmacist or qualified manager responsible for the operation, staff, and regulatory compliance of a pharmacy.
pharmacy-manager.exampleUsage: The pharmacy manager reviewed the daily records.

pharmacy-owner.definition: A person or organization that legally owns a pharmacy business.
pharmacy-owner.exampleUsage: The pharmacy owner is responsible for business operations and legal requirements.

pharmacy-representative.definition: A person who represents a pharmacy, supplier, or related organization in business or professional communication.
pharmacy-representative.exampleUsage: The pharmacy representative attended the supplier meeting.

pharmacy-trainee.definition: A person receiving supervised training in pharmacy work.
pharmacy-trainee.exampleUsage: The pharmacy trainee observed dispensing procedures under supervision.

drive-through-window.definition: A service window that customers can reach without leaving their vehicle.
drive-through-window.exampleUsage: The pharmacy has a drive-through window for collecting prepared orders.

consultation-room.definition: A private room where a pharmacist or healthcare professional can discuss health information with a patient.
consultation-room.exampleUsage: The pharmacist used the consultation room for a private conversation.

waiting-area.definition: A room in a place such as an airport or hotel where people sit until they are ready to leave or be served.

prescription-drop-off.definition: A counter or service point where a prescription is submitted to a pharmacy for processing.
prescription-drop-off.exampleUsage: The sign marks the prescription drop-off counter.

pick-up-counter.definition: A counter where customers collect items or orders that have already been prepared.
pick-up-counter.exampleUsage: Prepared pharmacy orders are collected at the pick-up counter.

health-poster.definition: A poster that presents public-health information or advice.
health-poster.exampleUsage: A health poster explained the importance of routine vaccination.

shopping-basket.definition: A portable basket used in a shop to hold items while you choose and purchase them.

bag.definition: A flexible container with a single opening.

loyalty-card.definition: A card or account that records purchases or provides customer rewards at a business.
loyalty-card.exampleUsage: The customer scanned a loyalty card for store points.

parking-lot.definition: An area with marked spaces where vehicles can be parked.
parking-lot.exampleUsage: The pharmacy parking lot has accessible spaces near the entrance.

wheelchair-access.definition: Features or routes designed so a person using a wheelchair can enter and move through a place.
wheelchair-access.exampleUsage: The entrance sign shows wheelchair access.

pharmacy-app.definition: A mobile application provided by a pharmacy for services such as account information, store details, or managing existing prescriptions.
pharmacy-app.exampleUsage: The pharmacy app shows store hours and order status.

online-refill.definition: A digital request to refill an existing prescription when allowed by the prescriber, pharmacy, and local rules.
online-refill.exampleUsage: The system shows whether an existing prescription is eligible for an online refill.
online-refill.arabicTranslation: طلب إعادة صرف وصفة عبر الإنترنت

courier-service.definition: A business service carries documents and packages between places, usually faster and more reliably than ordinary mail.

vaccination-clinic.definition: A healthcare service or location where trained professionals administer approved vaccines.
vaccination-clinic.exampleUsage: The pharmacy operates a vaccination clinic staffed by qualified healthcare professionals.

pill.definition: Something that resembles a tablet of medicine in shape or size.

pestle.definition: A club-shaped hand tool for grinding and mixing substances in a mortar.

medicine-bottle.definition: A container designed to hold medicine and carry its label and safety information.
medicine-bottle.exampleUsage: The medicine bottle had a child-resistant cap and a printed label.

label.definition: A brief description given for purposes of identification.

prescription-pad.definition: A paper or secure form used by authorized prescribers to write or issue prescriptions.
prescription-pad.exampleUsage: The prescription pad is used only by authorized healthcare professionals.

counter.definition: (computer science) a register whose contents go through a regular series of states (usually states indicating consecutive integers).

prescription.definition: A drug that is available only with written instructions from a doctor or dentist to a pharmacist.

dosage.definition: A measured portion of medicine taken at any one time.

refill.definition: A prescription drug that is provided again.

insurance.definition: Promise of reimbursement in the case of loss.

delivery.definition: The act of delivering or distributing something (as goods or mail).
